title: Marine Corps Marathon
blurb: Marathon weekend in the capital: 26.2 miles past the monuments, finishing at the Marine Corps War Memorial in 4:08:17.

title: Chicago Marathon
blurb: A flat, fast lap through Chicago's neighborhoods, finished in 3:53:09.

title: UNC vs. Duke
blurb: Flew home for one of the greatest Carolina–Duke games ever played. Seth Trimble buried a corner three at the buzzer to beat a stacked Duke team, and the Smith Center got its first court storm I've ever seen.
highlights: Storming the court in the Dean Dome
Rushing Franklin Street with Mom
Celebrating at Bob's with Duwe
Seeing Dad before flying back

title: Austin Marathon
blurb: Cheered on Maddy at the Austin Marathon: a brutally hilly course that finishes straight up a hill. Back in Austin for the first time in about 15 years, we went looking for the house we lived in until we were seven.
highlights: Watching Maddy conquer the hills
Wild Cat Hollow: our old street, now all new mansions
Exploring West Lake Hills
Rediscovering the city after 15 years

title: Puerto Rico
blurb: A week off with my cousin Will to celebrate him getting into med school at Marshall, and to thaw out after a brutal New York winter. Mission accomplished on collecting dad lore.
highlights: Hiking El Yunque National Forest
Skydiving together
Rooftops, great meals, and hot runs
Watching old teammate Brady Manek play against Jae Crowder
An Uber driver who was definitely drunk

title: Rob's Bachelor Party
blurb: Flew into SF and drove two hours north over the Golden Gate to an unreal Airbnb with UNC guys, NYC guys, and Rob's brothers and dad. Rolling green hills, cows, and cliffs over the Pacific; it felt like Scotland. Training camp started here.
highlights: Two rounds of links golf
Oysters, chips, and beers in a cove after golf
DJ's hill record on a half-mile climb
Catching Baylor Hayes (Tulsa QB1) throwing gas
Trail run through cow pastures to a private beach with Duwe and DJ
Giants game, on the Jumbotron, then red eyes home

title: Rob & Kai's Wedding
blurb: Flew down early for Rob and Kai's wedding, one of the most wholesome and refreshing weekends I can remember, surrounded by faithful, inspiring people. Training camp, part two.
highlights: Sunrise runs with Rob's dad and an intro to F3: faith, fellowship, fitness
Worship on the beach the morning of the wedding
Sweating it out together in the heat
Dance floor in a downpour

title: Fourth of July at Home
blurb: Home for the Fourth, and to say goodbye to Carly, our childhood black lab. She held on until Maddy and I could see her one last time. Being surrounded by family and love carried us through.
highlights: One last visit with Carly
Family all together

title: Cape Cod
blurb: Labor Day on the Cape with Collin Loughead and his family. A beautiful, picturesque, and very relaxing end to the summer.
highlights: An 18-mile long run: tough but rewarding
Peaceful afternoon on the boat
Blowing a lead to Michael Childress on the golf course
A cover band's farewell show at the Woodshed in Chatham
Burgers off the truck bed on the drive-on beach

title: Carolina Basketball Reunion
blurb: Reunion weekend with former players from every decade and their families, swapping stories and laughs. Great conversations about Dream On, too. It's so cool to be part of this family.
highlights: Big group photo and a dap from Danny Green
On the field at halftime of the ETSU game
Catching up in Vaughn Moore's box
Reunion dinner at the Smith Center
Seeing Dad before heading back

title: Arctos Super Day
blurb: Flew down for the Arctos case study, model test, and super day, then stayed the weekend to see if I could picture life in Dallas. I got the job!
highlights: Nailing the super day
16-mile Saturday run
College football and drinks with friends
Catching up with a high school friend at SMU

title: Navy vs. Tulsa
blurb: DJ and I drove down early Saturday (after a rather rambunctious night) to reunite with Rob, Kai, and the Hayes family for Navy vs. Tulsa.
highlights: An incredible Navy stadium
Great lunch and dinner with the crew

title: Dallas Scouting
blurb: Touring apartments in Uptown and West Village ahead of the move.

title: Flathead Lake
blurb: Four nights tucked into the mountains: hiking, coffee, reading, campfires and a few Coors Banquets.

title: Thanksgiving
blurb: Home to North Carolina for Thanksgiving.

title: Christmas
blurb: Christmas at home in North Carolina.

title: Sun Valley
blurb: Ringing in the new year in Sun Valley.

title: Tahoe Ski & Golf
blurb: Ski days in Tahoe, a round of golf nearby, and cheering on the Napa Valley Marathon.

title: New Home Base
blurb: Packing up New York and planting a flag in Dallas.
